column_semantics: The debt schedule has a single Interest Rate column, but for PIK instruments the printed Interest Rate cell breaks the rate into separate cash and PIK components, e.g. '<cash> % (Cash) <pik> % (PIK)'. For non-PIK floating-rate instruments, the Spread Above Reference Rate column shows the spread and the Interest Rate column shows the current cash rate. The stated cash component excludes PIK; PIK is quoted separately and additive.

rationale: The filing does not present PIK as a parenthetical included in an all-in rate. Instead, PIK positions print two separately labeled rate components within the Interest Rate column: one marked '(Cash)' and one marked '(PIK)'. Multiple schedule rows follow that pattern, including Valkyrie Intermediate, Athlete Buyer, ARC Health OPCO, and Caldwell & Gregory. Therefore a position-level stated cash rate means the cash leg only, with the printed PIK percentage separately quoted on top.
